text: dsh-always-on-top 是面向 DSH Desktop 的 Windows 插件，会在桌面窗口标题栏添加一个图钉按钮。点击按钮即可切换主窗口的始终置顶状态，按钮颜色和提示文字会同步显示当前状态。插件通过 DSH host 路由调用 Windows PowerShell 修改窗口样式，并将用户选择保存下来，在下次启动后尝试恢复。它还提供状态查询和显式设置接口，处理连续点击与操作失败。适合希望让 DSH Desktop 主窗口保持在其他窗口上方的 Windows 用户；需要 DSH Desktop 和 PowerShell，不需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-always-on-top adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar on Windows. Click to keep the main window above others; the button shows the current state. It saves the preference and attempts to restore it at launch. Requires DSH Desktop and PowerShell.
想让 DSH Desktop 窗口一直显示在其他窗口上面。
有没有办法给桌面版 DSH 加个一键置顶按钮？
我切到别的窗口后总找不到 DSH，怎么让它保持最前？
让 Windows 上的 DSH 主窗口可以快速置顶和取消置顶。
希望应用重启后还能恢复之前的窗口置顶状态。
DSH 的欢迎页和弹窗也会一起置顶吗？我只想固定主窗口。
How can I keep the DSH Desktop window above my other apps?
Add a title bar button to pin and unpin the Windows desktop window.
dsh-always-on-top 的功能「标题栏置顶」：在 DSH Desktop 标题栏加入图钉按钮，点击可切换主窗口的始终置顶状态；按钮颜色、提示和忙碌状态会随操作更新。
dsh-always-on-top 的功能「记住置顶状态」：主窗口置顶状态写入本机状态文件，客户端启动时读取期望状态，并在窗口可用后请求重新置顶。
dsh-always-on-top 的功能「平台适配」：检查 Windows 与 DSH Desktop 运行环境，不支持时移除标题栏按钮；支持时通过主机接口操作 Electron 主窗口。
dsh-always-on-top 的功能「查询和设置置顶」：主机提供状态查询、切换和显式设置接口；设置请求可传入 on 布尔值，失败时返回错误信息。
dsh-always-on-top 使用 Windows PowerShell 操作 DSH Desktop 主窗口，非 Windows 或非桌面运行环境不会显示按钮；置顶状态保存在本机 DSH_HOME 目录下。

A small DSH plugin — one host route and one client script. No dependencies, no build step, ~30 KB unpacked.

dsh-always-on-top README · Features：- A pin button in the title bar, immediately left of the Windows minimize button
- Toggles always-on-top through the Win32 `WS_EX_TOPMOST` window style
- Turns blue while pinned; the tooltip reads "Always on top — click to unpin"
- Remembers the state and re-applies it on the next launch
- Hides itself when not running inside DSH Desktop on Windows
dsh-always-on-top README · Install：The package is published on npm as `dsh-always-on-top`.

dsh-always-on-top README · Or add it to the desktop profile directly：pnpm -C "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop" add dsh-always-on-top

text:
dsh-always-on-top README · Usage：The pin sits at the right end of the title bar, left of the minimize button:

- grey: not pinned
- blue: always on top

Click to toggle. Tooltips follow the system language (English / Chinese).

dsh-always-on-top README · How it works：DSH Desktop is an Electron app, so the window belongs to the Electron main process. The plugin runs in the DSH host process, which the main process spawns — therefore `process.ppid` is exactly the process that owns the window.

dsh-always-on-top README · How it works：1. Click → the client sends `POST /dsh-always-on-top/toggle`
2. The host resolves the main window handle with `Get-Process -Id <ppid>`
3. A short PowerShell script calls `user32!SetWindowPos` to set or clear `WS_EX_TOPMOST` (`HWND_TOPMOST` / `HWND_NOTOPMOST`)
4. The host reads `GetWindowLong(GWL_EXSTYLE)` back and only reports success when the bit actually changed

No Electron changes, no main-process injection, no undocumented APIs.

dsh-always-on-top README · Compatibility：| | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| OS | Windows 10 / 11 |
| Runtime | DSH Desktop (Electron) |
| DSH | 0.2.x (`dsh.client` injection), tested on 0.2.1-rc.2 |

The button stays hidden in `dsh web` (browser) and on other operating systems.

dsh-always-on-top README · After a DSH upgrade：The button is positioned for the current title bar (42 px tall, ~138 px of window controls). If a future DSH release changes the title bar, adjust two numbers in the CSS in `lib/client.js`:

- button too far left/right or overlapping minimize → `right` (currently `146px`)
- button too high/low → `top` (currently `7px`)

dsh-always-on-top README · Limitations：- A toggle takes ~0.4–0.6 s (a PowerShell process compiles the P/Invoke declaration); the button shows a busy state
- State lives in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-always-on-top.json` (default `~/.dsh/`)
- Only the main window is affected; the welcome screen and update dialogs are not
